description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Array', a PHP class used for managing and rendering a sequence of markers in a graph rendering utility, specifically within the Image_Graph package. It includes methods for adding markers, drawing markers, and managing marker order.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Array
classes.description: A class for managing a sequential array of markers for graph data points, allowing addition and drawing of markers in sequence.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a marker to the internal marker array, optionally calling the parent add method if the marker is of type Image_Graph_Element.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the current marker at specified (x, y) position, cycling through the marker array.
